title: Sender Policy Framework (SPF) for Authorizing Use of Domains in Email, Version 1
summary: Email can be forged because existing protocols place no restriction on the MAIL FROM address or the HELO/EHLO domain a host uses. This document defines version 1 of the Sender Policy Framework, which lets domain owners say which hosts may send for them.

eli5.summary: Anyone can write any return address on an envelope. SPF lets a domain post a list of who is allowed to send as them.

questions: how does sender policy framework work
